name: Assassin's Creed Odyssey
notes: AnvilNext DX11 → D3DMetal (ACOdyssey AppDefaults d3d*=b). Ubisoft Connect CEF: win10; winhttp=b,n; dwrite=builtin (NOT empty — empty breaks libcef import); d2d1/d3d10core=d; Mac Driver RetinaMode=N Decorated=Y AllowOpenGL=Y. DO NOT re-add libEGL/libglesv2=d: the '9 Aug CX-style AppDefaults' set included them, and that is what caused the gl_factory_win.cc(63) NOTREACHED storm — a disabled override makes ntdll refuse Chromium's own ANGLE DLLs. Removed from the bottle registry and every launcher 12 Aug; Connect now paints and logs in. Note the CX Steam bottle having no upc AppDefaults was the tell, not a dead end. M4 16GB in-game: 1080p low–med ~70% scale.
